headline: Nigeria T-Bill Bids Reach N1.9 Trillion as Central Bank Cuts Stop Rates
summary: The Central Bank of Nigeria lowered Treasury bill stop rates across all three tenors despite receiving N1.91 trillion in total investor bids during Wednesday's auction.
why: Nigerian Treasury bill auctions determine sovereign borrowing costs and reflect banking sector liquidity across Africa's most populous economy.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Lower T-bill stop rates reduce government domestic debt service costs while trimming yields for bondholders.
